title: Context-rich source records for multi-row glyph constructions
scope: Curated read-only evidence for browsing source-art context beside glyph-combination candidates. No atlas, renderer, runtime vocabulary, or source artwork is changed.
claim_boundaries: A construction record is not a universal glyph meaning or one-glyph lookup.
Corpus frequency, drawn analogy, operator annotation, source-content reconstruction, mathematical family, and historical implementation limit are distinct evidence types.
AAHub occurrence counts describe their pinned corpus and unit; they do not prove meaning, quality, intent, or runtime use.
The historical old-typist 20-glyph / 38-degree constraints do not describe current MAIN and do not constrain these source examples.
